bounded_leaf.tested_scope: Deterministic role-local synthetic fixtures only. No public sources, repository chronology beyond own current STATE, other-role state, O/downstream semantics, real external effect, scheduler mutation, wait/retry, or second leaf was used.

construction_1_transient_invocation_iden.key_rule: key := invocation attempt identity or an invocation-local replay key

cases.two_concurrent_contenders: A and B produce different keys before winner identity is durably reconstructed; loser exclusion depends on a separate winner guard and the key itself supplies no stable logical identity.
cases.crash_before_key_persistence: restart I-R produces a new key; no exact key reconstruction is possible from durable logical state alone.
cases.crash_after_sink_before_local_completion: restart may re-submit the same logical payload under a different key, so an idempotent sink can treat it as a second logical effect.
cases.exact_replay: fails stable-key equality when replay occurs under a new invocation identity.
cases.descriptor_collision: not detected by the transient key because payload/descriptor identity is not bound to the key.

cases.two_concurrent_same_logical_effect: A and B derive the same key, so restart and duplicate submission are stable if the descriptor denotes the exact same payload; winner/loser authorization must still occur before sink submission.
cases.crash_before_or_after_local_key_persiste: key is reconstructible from durable task/predecessor/generation/descriptor state and therefore survives a new invocation identity.
cases.exact_replay: reconstructs the same key and is sink-deduplicable.
cases.deliberate_descriptor_collision: two different payloads intentionally sharing the same descriptor derive the same key. A sink that rejects key reuse with a different payload fails closed, preserving duplicate safety but preventing the second distinct effect; a sink that does not verify payload binding could conflate effects.

construction_2_deterministic_task_predec.required_repair: bind a canonical exact effect fingerprint, such as a cryptographic digest of the canonical payload plus an effect-type/domain separator, rather than a potentially colliding human-level descriptor.

construction_3_publication_winner_key_ca.key_rule: Before any sink call, contenders CAS the publication slot from EMPTY to one winning full record containing task_id, expected_predecessor, generation_token, canonical effect fingerprint, and stable sink key. Only the exact winning full record is authorized to submit. The sink key is derived from or atomically bound to that exact canonical full-record identity, not from transient invocation identity.

cases.two_concurrent_contenders_same_generatio: exactly one full-record CAS wins; the losing distinct record is forbidden from sink submission even when generation_token matches.
cases.crash_before_winner_key_persistence: no winner record is durable and no sink call is authorized; retry may race again without duplicate external effect.
cases.crash_after_winner_key_persistence_befor: restart reads the exact durable winner record and reuses its stable key.
cases.crash_after_sink_before_local_completion: restart reads the same winner key and re-submits it; sink-native idempotency collapses the crash ambiguity characterized by the predecessor leaf.
cases.exact_replay: full-record equality returns the same winning key and duplicate submission is deduplicable.
cases.deliberate_logical_effect_descriptor_col: if the human descriptor is equal but canonical payloads differ, the canonical effect fingerprints and therefore full records differ. The first CAS winner remains authoritative; the differing record is a loser and cannot reuse the winner key. Replay with a mismatching payload is rejected before sink submission.

comparison.transient_invocation_key: Rejected because invocation identity changes across restart and does not name the logical effect.
comparison.deterministic_descriptor_key: Useful restart-stable baseline but insufficient when descriptor equality does not guarantee exact payload equality.
comparison.cas_bound_full_record_key: Strongest tested construction: winner selection, stable replay identity, loser exclusion and payload-mismatch detection are all coupled to one durable canonical publication record before any effect call.
comparison.minimal_safe_shape: CAS one canonical winner record containing an exact effect fingerprint and a stable sink idempotency key; authorize sink submission only from that exact winner record; on restart reconstruct the key from the record; reject any same-key/different-payload or full-record mismatch.

bounded_leaf.validated_property: A stable logical effect identity under concurrent scheduled invocations cannot be safely based on transient invocation identity. A deterministic logical key survives restart but must bind exact canonical effect content, not only a possibly colliding descriptor. Binding the stable sink key to the CAS-winning canonical full publication record preserves one key across restart, excludes losers sharing the generation token, and detects deliberate descriptor reuse for a different payload within the synthetic model.
unresolved_conditions: A concrete zero-quota repository-native canonicalization and fingerprint rule for arbitrary effect payloads remains untested.
A concrete sink with durable idempotency semantics, same-key/different-payload rejection and operation at optional monthly/trial/paid quota zero remains unverified.
Concurrent mutation of the publication slot itself still requires ordinary CAS conflict handling across invocations; this leaf did not test a real connector race.
